blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Taytay town in Rizal recorded a heat index of 45.90 degrees Celsius at 9 a.m. on Thursday, placing it in the danger category, according to the local government. “Stay hydrated, avoid prolonged exposure to the sun, and limit strenuous outdoor activities during peak heat hours,” the Taytay Public Information Office (PIO) said in a Facebook advisory. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) defines the heat index as the temperature the human body experiences when air temperature and relative humidity are combined.
